# `aitbc config profiles save`

Save the current configuration as a named profile.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config profiles save [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Wallet name. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config profiles save --name <name>
```
